historicalBoundary: This file describes the post-challenge v4 graph. locagent-replication-fidelity.json remains the immutable description of the earlier c9584d0 experiment implementation.

reference.paper: LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization, ACL 2025

mechanisms.name: directory-file-class-function taxonomy
mechanisms.referenceEvidence: dependency_graph graph construction and the paper's heterogeneous entity hierarchy
mechanisms.adapter: MergeWarden stable IDs, immutable snapshot paths and functionKind metadata; Python methods are externally functions

mechanisms.name: CONTAINS/IMPORTS/CALLS/INHERITS navigation
mechanisms.adapter: LocAgent invokes is named CALLS; only uniquely proven lexical/import targets become traversable and repeated sites are aggregated

mechanisms.name: ordinary reference graph edges
mechanisms.referenceEvidence: Not required by the four selected LocAgent-style dependency relations
mechanisms.adapter: No reference index is built; ordinary occurrences remain available through immutable search_text

mechanisms.name: heuristic same-name and dynamic call edges
mechanisms.referenceEvidence: LocAgent's graph constructor may use language-specific heuristics
mechanisms.adapter: MergeWarden forbids repository-global same-name promotion and receiver guessing; uncertain sites remain diagnostics

mechanisms.name: entity/content search and bounded multi-hop traversal
mechanisms.adapter: Exact/BM25/fuzzy-last retrieval over the v4 generation, shared file chunks, source read required for evidence, explicit depth/node/byte caps

mechanisms.name: core/all scope layering
mechanisms.referenceEvidence: LocAgent motivates lightweight repository representation but does not define this cache identity or review scope policy
mechanisms.adapter: Changed and production Python form default core; all is explicit and independently published. Exact path rules include the source-declared generated SymPy integrals/rubi/rules tree without generalizing every rules directory.

mechanisms.name: streaming checkpoint and immutable generation storage
mechanisms.referenceEvidence: Engineering extension, not claimed as a LocAgent mechanism
mechanisms.adapter: Two-pass resolver, per-file extraction/relationship checkpoints, compact v4 SQLite, atomic publication and deterministic failure cache

limitations: Python only and head snapshot only
No receiver type inference, runtime dispatch, MRO execution or external dependency graph
No namespace-package or src-layout search-root inference
Candidate and unresolved dependency sites are diagnostic and never traversable
Reference equivalence is not claimed; review-quality benefit requires a separate frozen experiment
